label: COMMITMENT

points.heading: He makes plans ahead
points.body: Not just “what are you doing tonight?” but next week, next month.
points.panel: Notice whether he plans ahead with you.

points.heading: You meet his people
points.body: Friends and family suggest he sees you as part of his life.
points.panel: “Does he include me in his world?”

points.heading: Hard talks don’t scare him off
points.body: He stays and listens when things get serious.
points.panel: “Can we talk about something real for a minute?”

points.heading: You feel calm, not anxious
points.body: Steady love feels safe, not like guessing.
points.panel: “Do I feel secure most of the time?”

resource.name: The Devotion System
resource.covers: Guidance for confidence, communication, and long-term closeness.

caption:
When you’re hoping for something lasting, it’s easy to look for big gestures. But commitment usually shows up in small, steady things.

These four signs are worth noticing. If you’d like guidance for confidence, communication, and long-term closeness, there’s a resource at the link in bio. It’s a place to start, and no resource can promise how another person will feel or decide.
